diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions that fail to produce a new state, especially clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged state and forcing a strategy change should reduce action loops and improve progress per step. Cost: state comparison and replanning add modest computation and may prematurely redirect when delayed effects resemble repetition.
policy_text: After an action, compare the resulting state with the recent state history. If the same action or equivalent state recurs twice without measurable progress, do not repeat it unchanged; identify the blocking assumption and switch target, method, or information source before acting again.

quantitative_evidence.finding: result:repeated has +1,261 operations (11.31% of the 11,146 differential-profile total), the second-largest positive flat node; positive values denote candidate/bad excess.
Within repeated outcomes, candidate/bad excess includes +639 clicks, +356 no-ops, and +277 scrolls.
Traces reproduce consecutive repeated actions on the same target, including search clicks at steps 0006–0007 and buy_tickets clicks at steps 0014–0018.
